( temp Article)

[[Emperor Zerzies]] died heirless In 925 AFA, the result of this was the Empire shattering between the [[5 great houses]]; [[House Un Lie]], [[House Cin Lie]], [[House Trei Lie]], [[House Heiso]], and the [[New Kingdom of Asnaria]], Each House fighting for the ultimate goal. That being Restoring [[Areoix Lie]] under their [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruling_class rule]. [[Vurahi]] Would be under the control of [[House Un Lie]] at the start of the war. The City would be [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conscription#M levied], and soon after, the [[1st Siege of Vurahi]] would begin. In  928 AFA, after [[House Cin Lie]] crossed [[the blue river]]. The City's fate was sealed after the besieging army's Navy was destroyed in the [[Battle of Vurahi]] and the Lie's naval dominance was secured. After 6 years of a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege siege], the invading army of [[Terresin]] from the south would reach [[Vurahi]] while at the same time the [[House Un Lie|Un Lie]] relief force arrived, and they met in [[The Battle of the 3 kingdoms]]. The result was a catastrophic [[House Un Lie|Un Lie]] victory. [[House Cin Lie]] was destroyed and every last heir [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital_punishment executed] exept for [[Lord Viner Un Lie]] who fled to [[Moonaa]]. House Un Lie would proceed to dominate and vassalize its rivals, and in 943 AFA, the [[Treaty of the one throne]] was signed, bringing an end to an 18-year-long war. The country as a whole was decimated and depopulated. [[Vurahi]] was not exempt from the carnage. The [[1st Siege of Vurahi|siege]] had laid waste to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rural_area countryside], and Migrants flocked to [[Vurahi|the Imperial City]].
